formula: I(readmitted == "<30") ~ discharge_home + race + admission_source + specialty_group + age_group + diag_1_group + time_in_hospital + HbA1c_group + discharge_home:race + discharge_home:specialty_group + discharge_home:diag_1_group + discharge_home:time_in_hospital + specialty_group:time_in_hospital + specialty_group:age_group + diag_1_group:time_in_hospital + diag_1_group:HbA1c_group + (1|patient_nbr)
notes: Diabetes 130-US hospitals (Strack et al. 2014): 101766 encounters, patient_nbr repeats (up to 40 encounters per patient) so it is a genuine within-patient cluster. readmitted (NO/<30/>30) the documented target. Strack et al. de-duplicate to one encounter per patient and fit logistic regression (not mixed), so confidence low. encounter_id ignored; Hand sample #13 (O/low blind re-read): covariates and interactions are the final model of Strack et al. 2014 (sections 2.3-3, Tables 4-5): readmission within 30 days on the first encounter per patient, logistic, no random effects, so the patient intercept stays proposed. Recodes in the formula: discharge_home from discharge_disposition_id (home or other), admission_source from admission_source_id (emergency, referral, other), specialty_group from medical_specialty, age_group from age ([0,30), [30,60), [60,100)), diag_1_group the ICD-9 groups of diag_1, HbA1c_group from A1Cresult and change (no test, normal, high and changed, high and unchanged). RULE GAP: derived interaction; diag_1_group:HbA1c_group is in the formula only, diag_1:A1Cresult not being its encoding. Outside check: the formula keeps the recodes and the fields their raw columns, by the #162 ruling (a benchmark task's recode stays in the formula only). Screen #210: ? is declared missing in race, medical_specialty and diag_1 (2,273, 49,949 and 21 values): Strack et al. (2014, Table 1) give race 2% and medical specialty 53% missing, the shares of ? here.

notes: PAD-UFES-20 skin-lesion dataset (Pacheco et al. 2020): 2298 images, 1373 patients (up to 10 images/lesions per patient); diagnostic (6 lesion types) the documented classification target, patient_id the clustering unit. formula: final_result ~ gender + region + highest_education + imd_band + age_band + num_of_prev_attempts + studied_credits + disability + (1 | code_module:code_presentation) + (1 | id_student)
notes: OULAD (Kuzilek, Hlosta & Zdrahal 2017, Sci Data 4:170171; UCI 349 and its OULAD.names): one row per student registered on a module presentation (seven modules, 22 presentations), final_result Distinction, Pass, Fail or Withdrawn. Data Foundry's record (open_university_learning_analytics_dataset) builds a day-60 final_result task from the joined tables, holds out whole presentations and flags students who recur across registrations. No mixed model is published; the random intercepts per module presentation and per student on the codebook's demographic columns are the reader's proposal. Hand check #162: stands; final_result varies within 55% of the 3,538 students registered more than once. Screen #210: imd_band's ? is declared missing (1,111 values): the data descriptor documents empty fields, and the release writes them as ?, its only missing marker.

Readme (osf.io/download/3sn94); Rouault and Fleming 2020 PNAS, the metacognition experiment outside the scanner; its code (github.com/marionrouault/LocalGlobal) holds Matlab scripts with repeated-measures ANOVA and meta-d' fits, no mixed model. Rahnev et al. 2020 fit no model per file. Confidence, the database's measure, is the response; Response (the decision), Accuracy and the response times are alternate responses. Box numerosity at two difficulty levels calibrated per participant (Difficulty, the square difference), confidence 1-6, 41 participants; Confidence holds 999 beside NaN for missed ratings. Hand check #162: stands; Accuracy is in ignore. The paper (PMC7959580, Methods) fits per subject an ordinal regression of confidence on difficulty, accuracy, log decision RT and difficulty x accuracy, z-scored, and tests the coefficients at the group level, so the formula stays a proposal. Screen #210: Confidence's 999 is declared missing (19 values): the paper documents a rating from 1 to 6 and a time limit on it, the Confidence Database's readme writes missed ratings as NaN, and every 999 comes with an RT_conf of 0 or below.
